title: The Vanishing Coins
scene: At 8:20 PM, the arcade coin box was emptied. The machine room was sealed during a test from 8:00 to 8:30.

suspects.name: Wendy Cole
suspects.testimony: I was at the front counter at 8:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Wendy at 8:18 and 8:24.

suspects.name: Xavier Reed
suspects.alibiProof: The pinball counter shows Xavier's game at 8:19.

suspects.name: Yara Pike
suspects.testimony: I was fixing a machine on the floor at 8:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The floor camera shows Yara at 8:17 and 8:26.

suspects.name: Zane Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the machine room at 8:20, running the test.
suspects.contradiction: The machine room was locked from outside, and coin wrappers were in Zane's coat.
